lib/action-ir.js: read-only versioned candidate Action IR composing the L1 semantic record and the shipped external-action decision; pure contract, unit-tested, awaiting an execution surface that adopts it
lib/evidence-pack/control-matrix.js: evidence-pack SOC 2 control matrix and README-AUDITOR renderers: static supporting-evidence table plus pure deterministic renderers; unit-tested, awaiting the pack collector that writes controls/control-matrix.json and README-AUDITOR.md
lib/evidence-pack/manifest.js: evidence-pack manifest builder: file inventory, per-file SHA-256, and the packHash seal over the Trust receipt bundle; pure contract, unit-tested, awaiting the pack collector CLI that lands in the next slice
lib/evidence-pack/verify.js: evidence-pack verifier: recomputes packHash, checks every listed file's bytes, and re-verifies the receipt bundle through verifyExportedBundle; pure contract, unit-tested, awaiting the `huqan evidence verify` CLI command that lands in the next slice
lib/knowledge-lint.js: read-only knowledge health lint over the derived view; the scope note docs/architecture/knowledge-wiki-scope.md section 6 fixes its reporting-only boundary, and its report awaits the caller that renders the derived view, which leaves the ledger when it wires
lib/siem/formatters.js: ECS, Splunk HEC and CEF renderers over the canonical huqan.siem-event.v1; pure, unit-tested, awaiting the sink and cursor that write and move their output, which leave the ledger when they wire
lib/siem/siem-event.js: canonical huqan.siem-event.v1 mapper over external-action admission receipts; pure contract, unit-tested, awaiting the append-only sink that moves the event, which leaves the ledger when it wires
